<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/business/parcels/create/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a parcel on behalf of the business and reserves a locker. The request type is always **6** (Ramassage sur place / appless reservation) — it is not a request field. Debits the reservation fee from the wallet (prepaid) and sets the drop-off deadline (`expiresat`, default 72 h). Requires the **Business secret key**. Supports an optional `Idempotency-Key` header: an identical replay returns the first response and does not create a second parcel. For a prepaid business with insufficient balance it returns `statuscode` 99, `errorcode` `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` and message `"Insufficient balance. Required: <fee>, Available: <balance>"`. If never dropped off, the reservation expires (status 8), the locker is released and the fee is forfeited (no refund).
